VIC // OFF THE RECORD
This Week at EIC Nexus
Episódio · Presente simples vs. presente contínuo

Hey, it's Vic. I'm recording this from my usual spot. Headphones on, coffee going cold, door locked. You know the drill.

So, a lot is happening around campus this week, and I'm not just talking about the usual stuff.

First: Theo is helping organize the school event. I saw him running around the hallway with a clipboard yesterday, looking way too stressed for someone who normally keeps to himself. Someone should tell him it's going to be fine.

Meanwhile, Yara is teaching a dance class this week, which, honestly, makes sense. She's always the first person to point you in the right direction, so why not on a dance floor too?

Bia is rehearsing for the school play, a big change, since she usually just reads at the library at lunch. I walked past the gym and heard her going over the same line, like, five times. Dedication.

And Kai? Kai is editing a video for the school channel. He usually guides visitors around campus, so seeing him behind a screen instead of in front of people is a little strange, not gonna lie.

Everyone's busy. Everyone's doing something different than usual. That's this week at EIC Nexus.

That's it from me, off the record, as always.

VOCABULARY · GLOSSARIO
You know the drill
Você já sabe como é / já sabe a rotina
Used when something is so familiar you don't need to explain it in detail.
keeps to himself
Fica na dele, se isola
Describes someone who doesn't socialize much, prefers to be alone.
Meanwhile
Enquanto isso
Used to connect two things happening around the same time, often as a contrast.
